sentences.text: John Wick : Chapter 2 is a 2017 American neo-noir action thriller film directed by Chad Stahelski and written by Derek Kolstad .	Chad Stahelski	Chad Stahelski	neo-noir	neo-noir	action	Action film	thriller film	Thriller (genre)

The second installment of the John Wick series , the plot follows hitman John Wick , who goes on the run after a bounty is placed on his head .	John Wick series	John Wick (film series)	bounty	Bounty (reward)

It stars Keanu Reeves , Common , Laurence Fishburne , Riccardo Scamarcio , Ruby Rose , John Leguizamo and Ian McShane , and marks the first collaboration between Reeves and Fishburne since appearing together in The Matrix trilogy .	Keanu Reeves	Keanu Reeves	Common	Common (rapper)	Laurence Fishburne	Laurence Fishburne	Riccardo Scamarcio	Riccardo Scamarcio	Ruby Rose	Ruby Rose	John Leguizamo	John Leguizamo	Ian McShane	Ian McShane
Principal photography began on October 26 , 2015 , in New York City .	Principal photography	Principal photography	New York City	New York City
The film premiered in Los Angeles on January 30 , 2017 , and was theatrically released in the United States on February 10 , 2017 .	Los Angeles	Los Angeles
It received positive reviews from critics and grossed $ 166 million worldwide , over four times its $ 40 million budget and nearly twice the $ 88 million gross of the original film .
